## Notes

Social exchanges with one intent, preconditions, initiator and responder influence rule sets, and accept and reject instantiations; buddy, romance, and cool networks; Prom Week has 34 statuses, 44 traits, 3 relationships, and over 5,000 influence rules; social facts database treats events as known to all; volition from summed rule weights.
